name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: Floating side panel for record details, without a background scrim.
usage: Detail panels next to a list (a monitor, a batch).
notes: Sheets are non-modal by default: the list stays clickable, and selecting another record can update the open panel. Control `open` and `onOpenChange` from the selected record. `SheetContent` stays within a `Surface` when one is present. Use `SheetClose` or Escape to dismiss it.

reference.scope: Source reference; dashboard behavior cannot be verified on the public marketing site.
